content: French Testimonial from Diane Chevrett-A recent Hippocrates Health Educator Graduate who was the well-deserved winner of our prestigious Derrick Brockie award. Her story is compelling and we wish her a wonderful, continued journey changing lives and spreading the wellness message Hippocrates style! To learn more about Hippocrates Health Educator program please go to www.hippocratesinst.org.
